scope: Bounded verify/status snapshot consistency with cooperating writers

finding.before: Real CLI writer paused after revision publication before current replacement; concurrent verify and status immediately returned invalid despite normal publication. Regression failed for both commands.
finding.after: Both public read entrypoints acquire existing tracking lock; status calls internal already-locked verification and keeps lock through assessment and inventory.

additional_observations: For both verify and status, reader paused inside verification while holding lock; writer could not create workspace until reader released lock. Both finished successfully and archive hashes unchanged.
